body: ## Announcement Read the official announcement: [Announcing GoReleaser v2.18](https://goreleaser.com/blog/goreleaser-v2.18/). ## Changelog ### Security updates * 628c889d7f2a34066649833be419fdb9abe01174: sec(deps): bump golang.org/x/crypto and golang.org/x/mod (#6872) (@caarlos0) ### Bug fixes * e38e2fdbaccdbcca5829666567c13f194d126112: fix(archive): report stripped binary paths (#6820) (@davicbtoliveira) * 315a4fdf835630e29c96d90460dfc74d67895c68: fix(aursources): clarify error and document source.enabled requirement (#6816) (@0jaspahwa) *
